csv_project_name: Design For Taylor Education Building Renovation
csv_agency: University of Kentucky Capital Project Management
csv_scope_of_work: This program presents in summary, the requirements for the preparation of design and construction documents and estimates for Asset Preservation Pool Taylor Education Building and Dickey Hall Renovations at the University of Kentucky. This project consists of the comprehensive renovation of two adjacent academic buildings serving the University of Kentucky College of Education, delivered through the university s Asset Preservation Program. The Consultant will provide full professional design services from programming through project completion for both facilities.
csv_disciplines_requested: Interior Design/Space Planning, Programming, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Cost Estimating, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Utility Engineering

title: Design for Taylor Education Building Renovation
short_description: Design services for comprehensive renovation of two University of Kentucky academic buildings.
project_scope: Comprehensive renovation of two adjacent academic buildings, Taylor Education Building and Dickey Hall, for the University of Kentucky College of Education under the Asset Preservation Program. The consultant is to prepare design and construction documents and cost estimates for both facilities from programming through project completion. No gross floor area or detailed technical building characteristics are stated.
services: Full professional design services including programming, interior design/space planning, rehabilitation and refurbishment, civil engineering, structural engineering, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, utility engineering, cost estimating, and preparation of design and construction documents.
relevance_explanation:
- University building project, which is generally of strategic interest to sbp.
- Includes structural engineering as part of a full multidisciplinary design scope.
- Renovation of existing academic buildings may involve structural interventions, but no special structural complexity or long-span elements are described.
- Primarily a building renovation rather than an architecturally exceptional or lightweight structure.
- Good entry opportunity into an academic campus client, but limited evidence of standout structural innovation.

fee_explanation: No explicit fee information is provided in the tender documents.
